facts.text: Serve the cheeseburgers when the guests board the boat to the island.
facts.why: The cheeseburger comes right at the end. Margot complains she is still hungry and asks Slowik for a simple cheeseburger and fries, which he cooks himself. The boat trip is at the start of the film.
facts.fix: Serve the cheeseburgers when Margot asks Slowik for a cheeseburger.

facts.text: Every course tonight has a purpose. Put your phones away, and please, no substitutions.
facts.why: Slowik never says this. A real line of his, about the bread course, is 'Tonight, you get no bread.' His welcome speech also says 'Do not eat. Taste. Savor. Relish.'

vibe.verdict: A dark, sharp tasting menu that uses the bread plate, the tortillas, the s'mores and the burger, but the cheeseburger cue is in the wrong place.
